chunks: “When the landmarks are established and the boundaries are defined, there is no shuf'ah. And there is no shuf'ah except for a partner who has not divided the property.”

key_terms.أُرِّفَتِ: were marked or identified by landmarks
key_terms.الْأُرَفُ: the landmarks or distinguishing markers of property
key_terms.الْحُدُودُ: the defined boundaries of the property
key_terms.شُفْعَةَ: the right of pre-emption in jointly owned property
key_terms.لِشَرِيكٍ: for a co-owner or partner in the property
key_terms.مُقَاسِمٍ: one who has divided or partitioned the property

ai.seo_question: When does the right of shuf'ah apply in shared property according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states the legal principle of shuf'ah in shared property. Once the property has been distinctly marked and divided, the right of pre-emption no longer applies; it remains only for an undivided partner.
